public_rationale: LeCun's June 27, 2022 paper rejects scaling LLMs alone as sufficient for human-level intelligence, supporting the by-end-2022 component [e1]. In an interview published September 24, 2022, he described longstanding concerns about supervised and reinforcement learning, but did not date his adoption of the specific LLM critique [e2]. Neither record establishes that he adopted the qualifying critique before other relevant researchers, leaving the full claim unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: No comparative chronology establishes who adopted the qualifying critique first.
The relevant comparison group is unspecified.
The paper establishes LeCun's position by June 2022, not when he changed his mind.
Earlier criticism of other learning approaches does not establish earlier adoption of the specific LLM critique.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Yann LeCun was the first major AI thinker to come around to the critique of LLMs, having fully come around to his own, very similar critique by the end of 2022.

statement.excerpt: Yann LeCun was first, fully coming around to his own, very similar critique of LLMs by end of 2022.
statement.document_title: Game over for pure LLMs. Even Turing Award Winner Rich Sutton has gotten off the bus.

from_speaker: his own, very similar critique of LLMs
our_interpretation: Assess two components: LeCun publicly held a substantially similar critique by the end of 2022, and he had temporal priority among the relevant researchers coming around.
Substantially similar means rejecting scaling current language-model approaches alone as sufficient for general intelligence; it does not require identical proposed solutions.
The surrounding claim supplies a 2019 starting point for the asserted sequence.
'By end of 2022' is a retrospective cutoff, not a forecast deadline.
Do not assume that the date of one paper is the date LeCun first adopted the position.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records establish LeCun's qualifying critique by December 31, 2022, and a comparative chronology establishes that he was first among the relevant researchers to adopt it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: LeCun had not adopted the qualifying critique by the cutoff, or another qualifying researcher demonstrably adopted it before LeCun.
